description: Gaps found while building the probe registry (spikes/phase0-probe/src/models/registry.json): (1) no ONNX export exists for Moonshine Streaming Tiny or any per-language Moonshine Streaming Small checkpoint (ja etc.); (2) Moonshine Streaming Medium only has a community dynamic-int8 export whose MatMulInteger/DynamicQuantizeLinear nodes fall back to CPU on WebGPU; produce fp16 and q4 (MatMulNBits) exports; (3) Whisper/Moonshine merged decoders contain an If node (use_cache_branch); check placement and benchmark non-merged decoder_with_past graphs too; (4) catalog entries use community exports; pin revisions + hashes once chosen. Use optimum / the upstream exporters; add each to registry.json and run the models inspect/fixtures tooling.
title: Produce missing/WebGPU-friendly ONNX exports for catalog models
